contributions.anchor: line 1 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' Column A 'Total this Period' ($38,237.00) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the ledger's own printed 'Gross Donations: Cash, Loaned, In-Kind: $ 38,237.00' at the foot of Schedule A, and is repeated at summary line 4
contributions.detail: 28 contribution rows on one Schedule A sheet. The 16 CASH rows sum to 28,615.00 = the ledger's printed 'Donations This Period' cash figure AND its printed 'Total Cash Donations: $ 28,615.00'. The 12 IN-KIND rows sum to 9,622.00 = the printed in-kind figure on the same 'Donations This Period' line. 28,615.00 + 9,622.00 = 38,237.00 exactly = the printed 'Gross Donations' = summary line 1 Column A = line 4. The 'Amt Loaned' column is a printed bare dash on every row and its total prints as a dash — no loan this period. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' is handwritten 66,650.88 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment. The ladder closes as printed: line 3 (7,003.10) + line 4 (38,237.00) = line 5 (45,240.10), minus line 6 (37,182.65) = line 7 (8,057.45).

expenditures.anchor: line 2 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE' Column A 'Total this Period' ($37,182.65) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the ledger's own printed 'Gross Expenditures: $ 37,182.65' at the foot of Schedule B sheet 2, and is repeated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 67 expenditure rows over two Schedule B sheets. The 55 CASH rows sum to 16,675.11 (p4) + 10,885.54 (p5) = 27,560.65 = the printed 'Summary of Expenditures/Loan Repayments' cash figure. The 12 IN-KIND rows (all on p4) sum to 9,622.00 = the printed in-kind figure beside it — the same 9,622.00 the contribution side carries, because this filer enters every in-kind gift TWICE, once as a contribution and once as an offsetting expenditure of the identical date and amount. 27,560.65 + 9,622.00 = 37,182.65 exactly = the printed 'Gross Expenditures' = summary line 2 Column A = line 6. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' is handwritten 58,516.22 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment, and never differenced against another filing.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on BOTH sides — and this filing is a live instance of ADDENDUM G1 (in-kind treatment is a per-FILING property). Both conventions were tested on both sides against the figures this document prints: monetary-only gives 28,615.00 / 27,560.65, which reconcile to the ledger's own 'Total Cash Donations' and cash-column footer but fall 9,622.00 short of the PROMOTED Column A on each side; monetary-plus-in-kind gives 38,237.00 / 37,182.65, which are exactly the promoted line 1 and line 2 figures. So the in-kind rows are inside the anchor and are published with in_kind=true. NOTE how different this is from the same filer's June report in this chunk (dd75bb17 / 0b284ae6), whose ledger has no in-kind column at all — the convention was NOT carried forward, it was tested here from scratch.
itemized.escalation_note: One escalation, for LEGIBILITY not truth: the Schedule A row-1 donor cell was cropped across the whole name column at 900 dpi (pct:14.0,12.24,48.0,1.3@p3) to establish whether its truncated text was a scan defect. It rendered 'heperd Grip & Lighting (Campaign HQ Lease: April 24, 2020 - June 24, 202(' — the truncation is IN THE DOCUMENT (a spreadsheet cell clipped against its occupied neighbours), so the cell is transcribed exactly as printed and nothing was reconstructed. THIS IS A DIFFERENT REPORT FROM THE OTHER THREE SAKIEVICH FILINGS IN THIS CHUNK: the cover ticks 'Seven days preceding the General Election', the signature and Date of Report read 'OCTOBER 27, 2020', and the amendment question is ticked 'No'. Its line 3 'Balance at Beginning' prints 7,003.10 — which is what the June report's line 7 states — an observed chain recorded here, never used as a gate and never differenced. THE LEDGER GAINED TWO COLUMNS since June: Schedule A now prints Cash Amount / Amt Loaned / Amt In-Kind and Schedule B prints Expenditures in Cash / Expenditures In-Kind, and the in-kind rows are entered on BOTH sides (identical dates and amounts, 9,622.00 each), which is why both sides close only WITH in-kind. Sakievich' vs channel label 'Tom Sakievich'; office is typed 'Utah County Commission' and hand-written again on the 'Office:' line, with NO SEAT LETTER, while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C' from the channel — the seat is NOT inferred. Political Party typed 'Republican'. REDACTION: only the signature block is blacked out by the county; every donor and vendor address is published in the clear and the reduction to city/state (contributions) and to nothing (expenditures) is applied by THIS transcription at read time. Schedule B prints ONE combined 'To/Name:Nature of Expense' column (ADDENDUM G3): payee and purpose are assigned BY CONTENT — the filer's own colon or trailing parenthetical where he uses one, the whole cell as the vendor where he names only a payee, and on SIX rows where the cell states only what was bought the payee is taken from the 'Mailling Address' column that names the business (SBD Printing, Lowe's Hardware, U.S. Post Office, Hallmark) or the vendor's URL (www.simpletexting.com, www.gopshop.com), each flagged in its own row note.
